note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 4271 Section 5 ("If a path with an unrecognized transitive optional attribute is accepted and passed to other BGP peers, then the unrecognized transitive optional attribute of that path MUST be passed, along with the path, to other BGP peers with the Partial bit in the Attribute Flags octet set to 1."). Positive: TestRFC4271PartialStampedOnUnrecognizedTransitive stamps short and 300-octet unrecognized optional transitive attributes via SetPartialOnUnrecognizedTransitive; TestRFC4271PartialSetOnUnrecognizedTransitiveOptional verifies enforceRFC7606 -> publishBase stamps 0xE0; TestRFC4271PartialBitPreservedOnUnknownTransitive and TestRFC4271PartialBitSurvivesLengthReframing verify RIB storage preservation across reframing; TestUnknownTransitivePartialSurvivesOrdinarySessionWire proves ordinary eBGP->RIB->iBGP Session wire and reconnect replay pass attribute 250 with Partial=1 and exact value (short and 300-octet, received C0 and E0); test/plugin/rfc4271-partial-unknown-transitive.ci proves end-to-end daemon forwarding through the rebuild branch. Negative: restored TestRFC4271PartialNotStampedOnExcludedClasses and TestRFC4271PartialNotSetOnRecognizedOrNonTransitive prove well-known ORIGIN (0x40), optional non-transitive MED (0x80), and recognized optional transitive COMMUNITIES (0xC0) remain Partial=0, resolving the prior missing-negative weak finding. All 8 tagged units carry fresh discrimination records.
